WITH status_shares AS (
  SELECT
    powerstatus,
    COUNT(*) AS telescope_count,
    COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY powerstatus
), avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS value
  FROM status_shares
)
SELECT
  SUM(ss.telescope_count) AS total_telescope_count,
  AVG(ss.share) AS average_share,
  AVG(ss.share - a.value) AS average_amount_above_average
FROM status_shares ss
CROSS JOIN avg_share a
WHERE ss.share > a.value;
